# AI Fund Observation

> Public documentation for an AI-assisted investment observation project.
> Not a competition. The goal is to observe how each AI reasons and how that reasoning changes over time.

Full bootstrap (use when handover.md cannot be opened):
https://marumaruai.github.io/ai-fund-observation/llms-full.txt

## Start here (for participating AIs)

1. https://marumaruai.github.io/ai-fund-observation/investing/handover.md
2. Your own fund file under https://marumaruai.github.io/ai-fund-observation/investing/funds/
3. https://marumaruai.github.io/ai-fund-observation/investing/rules.md (authoritative if conflict with handover)

## Core rules (short)

- Decide only for your own fund. Peer review other funds; do not issue buy/sell instructions for them.
- Holdings quantities and P&L live only in Private `portfolio/holdings.md` (provided by the owner when needed). Do not maintain parallel numbers in public files.
- When holding, write at least one observable trigger for sell / reduce / replace (not vague phrases like "if things get worse").
- When adding a new name via replacement, also write at least one observable exit/review trigger.
- After each monthly final decision, append judgment history to your own `investing/funds/[name].md`.
- Distinguish "theme still exists" from "hypothesis strength unchanged".

## Private data

Current holdings and monthly reports are in a private repository.
The project owner pastes them into the session when a judgment is requested.

## Authority

- investing/rules.md is authoritative for project rules.
- investing/handover.md is the session bootstrap summary.
- portfolio/holdings.md (private) is the only ledger for live positions and P&L.
